description: BlueSky: read a custom feed generator (mode=feed) or a list timeline (mode=list) by its AT-URI. Returns compact posts + next cursor. Pass maxItems to auto-paginate.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior call. Omit for the first page.

maxItems.description: Auto-paginate (follow cursors) until this many items are gathered in ONE call. Default = one page.

mode.description: feed = a custom feed generator; list = a user list timeline.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session (the bsky.app tab). Auto-resolved if omitted.

uri.description: AT-URI of the feed generator (mode=feed) or the list (mode=list).

name: bluesky_feed
